description:
Product CSV workflows: template generates a fillable CSV with recommended columns, sample rows, variant fields and image mapping; export dumps store products as CSV (scope: all / demo = template samples / user = seller products); import bulk-creates products, variants AND detail specs from one CSV.
Import CSV format — core columns: title, sku, price, compare_price, description, category_top, category_sub, stock_qty, status, image_url_1..6 (or image_urls pipe-separated, or image_src). Variant columns: option1_name/option1_value..option3 or variant_1_name/variant_1_value.., plus variant_sku, variant_price, variant_stock, variant_image; plain size/color columns also work (size-like names → size, colour-like → colour, others kept as attributes). Detail columns: specifications (or technical_specs), whats_in_the_box, features, care_instructions, size_guide, shipping_returns, faq ("Question: … Answer: …" separated by | or newline), brand, tags. Rows sharing a handle/group/parent_sku column merge into ONE product with many variants (Shopify exports work directly); without a group column each titled row is a product and title-less rows attach to the product above. Upserts on product SKU. Max 1000 rows / 500 products.

csv.description: import: full CSV content as a string (header row + data rows)

imageMode.description: template: urls = public HTTPS images; filenames = local media folder mapping; uploadedUrls = already-uploaded Social AI URLs

projectId.description: Website project ID — required for export/import

replaceDemoProducts.description: import: delete template demo/sample products first (default false)

replaceVariants.description: import: clear a product's existing variants before inserting CSV variants so re-imports do not duplicate (default true)

rows.description: template: number of sample rows (default 3, max 10)

storeType.description: template: e.g. clothing, shoes, electronics, beauty, food, services

name: product_csv
